scope: Saved source provenance, numerical accounting, negative results, bilingual report parity, local links and publication QA records. No model retraining, stochastic reruns, new chemistry or physical validation.

items.check: original source execution and audit hashes
compatibility source execution and audit hashes
failed intermediate source and execution retained
original failure and repaired completion retained
exactly four API repairs and no scientific replacement
audit tied to captured execution values
source audit output nonempty hash inventory
source audit 264 forwards and 13 model initializations
audit performs no additional kMC or conformer search
12 initialization seeds each cover six molecules
32 priority seeds each rank six molecules
untrained source and random uncertainty are not relabeled as fitted
source curve fixed numerical entries retained
official FreeSolv snapshot and license hashes
selected labels and uncertainty fields match archived official data
no duplicated selected molecule IDs or canonical structures
declared grouping has no split leakage
four actual training runs and 240 epochs
latent scaler uses training IDs only
latent scaler mean and scale reconstructed
mixed neural versus ridge result retained
24 campaigns with 16 actual unique cached calls
